cooldown_value_changes.title: Cooldown value changes
cooldown_value_changes.titleFormatted: Cooldown value changes for [[cooldownTime]] seconds per [[entityKey]]
cooldown_value_changes.hint: Allows immediate triggers but blocks follow-up triggers until there's a gap of no events for the specified time. Each unique entity value will have its own cooldown timer.
cooldown_value_changes.entity_identifier_hint: The key to use for identifying different entities. This should be a token from a previous card that uniquely identifies each entity (e.g., room name, device ID, etc.).
